mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALARM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
SELECT ALARM_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_ID, IS_READ, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT FROM ALARM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ALARM_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ALARM SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE ALARM_ID = #{alarmId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ALARM (USER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkId})
